A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
TMG caps are not required for RNP assembly and function, but their presence may confer a selective advantage for some RNP species, such as U1 snRNAs.

The main takeaway from our work is that
CBP is a newly identified, gained component of U1 snRNAs that are otherwise structurally normal in tgs1 cells.
